description:
SourceDefinition is a single source entry in kind.json: a path to
 the source configuration file plus optional `schema` — a JSON
 Schema file describing the source's shape, resolved the same way
 KindDefinition.schema resolves the spec schema. A source with no
 `schema` behaves exactly as before: raw content, no per-source
 typing. Declaring `schema` makes the source's final content a
 contract the runner enforces regardless of whether any hook binds
 to it as typed (see RenderHookDefinition.source).

path.description:
Path to the source file. Resolved relative to the enclosing
 kind.json file.

schema.description:
Path to a JSON Schema file describing this source's shape.
 Resolved relative to the enclosing kind.json file. Optional —
 omit for a source with no declared shape.

title: Source Definition
